name: claude-code-playbooks
description: Search a library of ready-made instruction templates for AI agents and retrieve the one that fits your task.

interface.longDescription: Search a library of more than 1,200 ready-made instruction templates for AI agents, covering research, finance, marketing, legal review, file organization and more. Describe a task to get matching playbooks with what each one does, who it is for, its full template, and a link to its original source where known. Templates are written as CLAUDE.md files and Skills, and you can adapt them for other AI tools. The plugin is read-only and does not access your files or accounts. This is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Anthropic.
defaultPrompt: Find a playbook for invoice automation.
Find a literature review playbook and show me its template.
What categories of playbooks are available?

positive.prompt: Find a playbook for invoice automation.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching playbooks, including Invoice Automation, with a short description and a link to each playbook page.

positive.prompt: Find a literature review playbook and show me its template.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a literature review playbook, then shows its full template with a link to the playbook page and its source where one is known.

positive.prompt: What categories of playbooks are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the playbook categories with how many playbooks each one has.

positive.prompt: Find a beginner playbook for organizing files.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only beginner-level file organization playbooks, with links to their pages.

positive.prompt: Find a playbook for underwater basket weaving.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no matching playbook was found, without inventing one, and may suggest a broader search or browsing categories.
